title: Data Operations - Private Markets, Vice President, Investment Management
description:
**Vice President, Data Operations — Private Markets:**

  

Morgan Stanley Investment Management (MSIM) is one of the largest global asset management organizations of any full\-service securities firm, with more than 50 years of history, a presence in 26 countries, and a total of $2 trillion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026\.


MSIM provides broad\-based specialization across a range of asset classes in public and private markets. Our independent investment teams leverage Morgan Stanley’s global resources to serve a diverse client base of governments, institutions, corporations, advisors and individuals worldwide. Our investment solutions include a broad range of alternatives, high\-conviction active strategies, customization strategies, ESG expertise and tax management solutions. For further information about Morgan Stanley Investment Management, please visit www.morganstanley.com/im .


MSIM is at an important point in the evolution of its data capabilities. As a global investment manager with significant scale, continued growth, an increasingly diverse investment platform, and growing demand for data, analytics, and AI, we have a compelling opportunity to reimagine how data is organized, governed, architected, and consumed across the firm.


We are seeking an experienced Vice President, Data Operations — Private Markets to play a critical role in advancing the data operating model across MSIM's Private Markets platform. The role will be responsible for establishing and operating governance and controls over data received from external fund administrators and internal platforms, helping ensure that critical investment and operational data is complete, accurate, timely, traceable and fit for use across the organization.

  

The Vice President, Data Operations will work across Operations, Investment teams, Technology, Data Governance, Finance, Risk and external service providers to translate business processes and data requirements into practical governance, data quality and control frameworks. The role will establish clear accountability for data, drive consistent standards across sources and platforms, and help ensure that data issues are identified, understood and remediated as close to source as possible.

  

This is an opportunity to help shape how Private Markets manages data as the platform continues to scale and modernize. The successful candidate will combine a strong understanding of Private Markets operations with data governance expertise, a rigorous control mindset and the ability to influence across business, technology and external partners. The role will help move the organization from fragmented and manually intensive data processes toward a more standardized, transparent and exception\-driven operating model.


The successful candidate will help create an operating environment in which Private Markets data is easier to understand, govern, trust and consume. They will establish practical governance over critical data elements, data quality, ownership, lineage and issue management while maintaining the controls and accountability expected within a regulated financial institution. This role requires someone who can operate at both the strategic and execution levels—helping define the target operating model while remaining sufficiently close to the data and underlying business processes to ensure governance standards translate into practical outcomes.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Establish and operate data governance and quality frameworks for critical Private Markets data received from fund administrators, third\-party providers and internal platforms.
* Define and maintain Critical Data Elements (CDEs), data ownership, business definitions, sourcing requirements and data quality standards across key Private Markets data domains.
* Own data quality oversight, including completeness, accuracy, timeliness and consistency controls, exception management, issue tracking and remediation governance.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and sustainable remediation of data issues, partnering with fund administrators and internal data providers to address recurring issues at source.
* Establish and maintain business data lineage and traceability across critical data flows, from source through transformation and downstream consumption.
* Develop data quality rules, tolerances and preventative controls that reflect underlying business processes, materiality and downstream data usage.
* Partner with Technology and Data Governance on data onboarding, platform enhancements, governance tooling and implementation of scalable data\-quality capabilities.
* Develop KPIs and management reporting covering data quality, timeliness, exceptions, remediation and recurring issues, using trends to drive continuous improvement.
* Represent Private Markets Data Operations in relevant governance forums and partner with stakeholders across Operations, Investment teams, Finance, Risk, Technology and other consumers of Private Markets data.
* Contribute to the continued development of the Private Markets Data Operations operating model, including increased automation, exception\-based processing and clear accountability across global teams.
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* 10–14\+ years of experience in investment management, financial services or a similarly complex data environment, with meaningful experience in Data Operations, Investment Operations, data governance or related functions.
* Strong understanding of Private Markets data and operating processes, ideally across private equity, private credit, real estate, infrastructure and other alternative investment strategies.
* Experience working with data supplied by fund administrators, third\-party service providers and internal investment, accounting or operational platforms.
* Practical experience establishing or operating data governance and data quality frameworks, including CDEs, data ownership, business definitions, lineage, data quality rules, issue management and controls.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate complex data issues, identify root causes and drive sustainable remediation across organizational and external\-provider boundaries.
* Strong understanding of operational controls and experience operating within a regulated financial\-services environment.
* Experience partnering with Technology and data teams to translate business requirements into scalable data processes, controls and platform capabilities.
* Familiarity with Private Markets and fund accounting platforms such as eFront, Investran or comparable platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance, cataloguing and data\-quality tooling and modern data platforms is beneficial.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with demonstrated ability to influence across business, technology and external partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, Data Management or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  

**Who You Are:**

  

* Operates with a strong sense of ethics and integrity in interactions with others and decision making.
* Takes accountability and ownership with a focus on delivering sustainable, long\-term outcomes.
* Brings a strong control mindset and applies sound judgment when managing data quality issues and exceptions.
* Collaborates across teams and organizational boundaries to deliver effective solutions.
* Combines attention to detail with the ability to understand broader business processes and data dependencies.
* Pursues continuous improvement and operational modernization, challenging existing processes constructively.
* Communicates clearly, translating complex data and operational issues into business implications and actions.
* Commits to developing others and contributing to a collaborative, high\-performing team environment.

Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. The successful candidate will operate as a business analyst within the Direct Custody Business Design \& Deployment team, supporting senior workstream leads and partnering with Product, Operations, Technology, Vendors, Market Infrastructures and Control Functions. Following implementation, the role may support subsequent market launches or transition into the relevant BAU Direct Custody operations.


**Why this role is important to us**

State Street is progressing a strategic transformation from sub\-custodian arrangements to direct market participation across key markets. Project requires a coordinated operating model across T2S direct markets, non\-direct and sub\-custodian routes, multiple client archetypes, account structures and market\-specific exception mechanisms.


This role is critical to:


* **Supporting controlled direct\-market implementation** through accurate business analysis, requirements documentation, testing and operational\-readiness execution.
* **Supporting a scalable and integrated service model** across settlement and market\-facing activities, while aligning upstream processing with the existing operating model.
* **Documenting client and market\-specific complexity** by distinguishing standard custody processing from exceptions requiring operating\-model, technology and control closure.
* **Building sustainable internal capability** through documented processes, training, knowledge transfer and reusable implementation artefacts.

**Key responsibilities (Direct Custody aligned)**

* **Market, Client and Account\-Structure Analysis**
* Analyse market rules, clients, transaction volumes, operating locations and service requirements across Italy, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and associated non\-direct routes.
* Gather and analyse requirements for the different client archetypes and local market participants.
* Document operational requirements for Cash \& Securities Account structures.
* Review existing roles and responsibilities and identify functional, process, control and ownership deltas against the target Direct Custody model.
* **Target Operating Model and End\-to\-End Process Design**
* Support the design and documentation of target\-state processes aligned to State Street capabilities and the Direct Custody Target Operating Model across settlement, cash and liquidity, corporate actions, income, reconciliation and client servicing.
* Prepare process flows for T2S direct markets, including Euronext Securities Milan, Clearstream Banking Frankfurt and ESES markets, and document interfaces with non\-direct or sub\-custodian routes.
* Support definition of operating models for traditional OTC activity, ONEX flows, and applicable settlement or netting types.
* Identify process dependencies, hand\-offs, exception ownership, service\-level requirements and escalation paths across internal and external parties.
* **Market\-Specific Mechanisms and Exception Design**
* Gather and document requirements, operating controls and design considerations for market specifics such as auto\-collateralisation, auto\-borrowing, French registration and deregistration and corresponding market notifications.
* Gather and document requirements, operating controls and design considerations for client specifics such as pool creation and specialised Hold \& Release processing, including control points, eligibility logic and operational ownership.
* Support portfolio\-transfer analysis and documentation of market\-specific position reflection or rebuild requirements.
* **Business Requirements, Technology and Vendor Engagement**
* Prepare and maintain business requirements, user stories, process maps, functional clarifications and traceability across business, technology and vendor deliverables.
* Analyse vendor and application capabilities, document functional and integration gaps, and support definition of remediation or target\-state solutions.
* Partner with Technology and vendors to document interface requirements, data mapping, messaging, workflow and exception\-management capabilities.
* Review vendor Functional Solution Documents, record comments and gaps, and support senior business approval of the proposed design.
* Maintain scope, dependency, decision, action and issue logs, with clear impact assessment and timely escalation to workstream leads.
* **Testing, Operational Readiness and Implementation**
* Develop detailed test scenarios and test cases covering standard processing, client/market variants, exceptions, controls and end\-to\-end integration.
* Execute or coordinate system integration testing, market testing and user acceptance testing, including defect logging, remediation validation, retesting and regression testing.
* Maintain business\-readiness assessments across operating procedures, staffing, access, static data, connectivity, controls, reporting and contingency arrangements.
* Prepare evidence and status reporting to support go\-live and client\-conversion decisions, risk assessment and stakeholder sign\-off.
* Support implementation, stabilisation and structured handover into the Direct Custody BAU organisation.
* **Risk, Controls, Compliance and Operational Resilience**
* Document risk, compliance and governance requirements within the target operating model and solution deliverables.
* Support operational resilience and business\-continuity readiness, including critical process documentation, recovery requirements and BCP knowledge transfer.
* Assist with business\-function, control and organisational\-framework setup, risk assessments and evidence requirements.
* Coordinate access, security and identity\-governance requirements, including role mapping, approvals and segregation\-of\-duties evidence.
* Track regulatory, market\-infrastructure and connectivity requirements through to closure before implementation.
* **Procedures, Training and Knowledge Transfer**
* Review existing procedures and Business Process Maps to determine applicability and gaps for new Direct Custody functions.
* Draft and maintain market\- and application\-specific SOPs, control procedures, operating guides and process documentation aligned to the Target Operating Model.
* Prepare and support delivery of training on market structures, applications, operating processes, exceptions and controls for implementation, BAU and BCP teams.
* Support structured handover, cross\-training and maintenance of reusable artefacts for future Direct Custody market launches.
* **Stakeholder Coordination and Delivery Support**
* Coordinate assigned activities and provide analytical, documentation and subject\-matter support to senior workstream leads and project resources.
* Partner across Product, Operations, Technology, vendors, Market Agents, Risk, Compliance, Client Service and other internal stakeholders.
* Prepare workshop materials, capture requirements, decisions and actions, and communicate operational matters clearly to stakeholders.
* Escalate business\-design and readiness issues promptly, ensuring risks, dependencies and decisions are transparent and tracked to resolution.
* Promote standardisation, automation, operational resilience and continuous improvement across the regional and global Direct Custody operating model.
  

**Operational analytics and reporting**

* Build and maintain implementation dashboards covering requirements, design decisions, gaps, testing, defects, controls, training and operational\-readiness milestones.
* Maintain implementation dashboards covering requirements, design decisions, gaps, testing, defects, controls, training and operational\-readiness milestones.
* Produce concise workstream reporting on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, remediation actions and readiness status.
* Support capacity, footprint and workforce planning for phased market delivery and transition into BAU operations.
* Use defect, exception and post\-implementation metrics to support root\-cause analysis and identify opportunities for control enhancement, process standardisation and automation.
  

**Qualifications and experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Technology or a related discipline; a Master's degree, MBA or relevant professional qualification is advantageous.
* Typically, 6\-9 years of experience in securities services, custody, post\-trade operations, business analysis, testing or transformation delivery.
* Good knowledge of securities settlement and familiarity with cash and liquidity, reconciliation, corporate actions and income processes within a global custody or direct custody environment.
* Practical understanding of T2S, European CSD/ICSD models, Dedicated Cash Accounts, settlement messaging, market cut\-offs and exception management.
* Experience producing business requirements, user stories, process maps, test scenarios, test evidence, SOPs, training materials and project reporting.
* Experience supporting vendor engagement, application assessment, testing, implementation readiness, risk and control activities, and operational handover.
* Strong analytical, communication, documentation and stakeholder\-coordination skills, with the ability to convert complex market requirements into clear and implementable deliverables.
* Working knowledge of SWIFT settlement and cash messaging and ISO 20022 is preferred

Billing Operations \& Bill Run Processing

* Coordinate reconciliations across CRM, mediation, billing, invoicing and downstream systems, ensuring timely resolution of exceptions.

* Contribute to continual improvement initiatives focused on billing accuracy, operational efficiency, reduced manual effort and faster issue resolution.

description:
Production Manager – uPVC Windows \& Doors

Department: Production / Manufacturing

Designation: Production Manager

Industry: uPVC Windows \& Doors

Location: Maharashtra

Reporting To: Plant Head / General Manager / Management

Role Purpose

To manage and control the complete production operations of the uPVC windows and doors manufacturing unit, ensuring timely production, consistent quality, optimum manpower utilization, minimum material wastage, and adherence to project/site delivery schedules.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Production Planning \& Execution

\- Prepare daily, weekly and monthly production plans based on project requirements and dispatch schedules.

\- Monitor production from cutting → reinforcement → welding → cleaning → hardware → glazing → final inspection → packing → dispatch.

\- Ensure production targets are achieved within defined timelines.

\- Coordinate with sales, project/site and dispatch teams for priority requirements.

2\. Manpower Management

\- Plan and allocate manpower across different production activities.

\- Manage skilled and semi\-skilled workers and ensure optimum utilization.

\- Monitor attendance, productivity and performance.

\- Identify manpower requirements and coordinate with management for recruitment/training.

3\. Quality Control

\- Ensure production is carried out as per approved drawings, specifications and quality standards.

\- Monitor critical parameters such as dimensions, welding quality, sash/frame alignment, reinforcement, hardware installation, glass fitment and drainage provisions.

\- Implement inspection procedures at various stages of production.

\- Identify recurring defects and take corrective/preventive action.

4\. Material \& Inventory Control

\- Coordinate with stores and purchase teams for timely availability of profiles, reinforcement, hardware, glass, gaskets, accessories and consumables.

\- Minimize material wastage and optimize profile cutting.

\- Monitor production scrap and material consumption.

\- Ensure proper storage and handling of profiles, glass and finished products.

5\. Machine \& Factory Management

\- Ensure proper operation and maintenance of welding, corner cleaning, cutting, routing, drilling, glazing and other production equipment.

\- Coordinate preventive maintenance to minimize machine downtime.

\- Maintain a safe, organized and efficient production floor.

6\. Project \& Delivery Coordination

\- Review project\-wise production requirements and pending quantities.

\- Coordinate with the project/site team regarding measurements, revisions, priorities and dispatch requirements.

\- Ensure production is aligned with committed delivery schedules.

\- Provide regular production status and pending reports to management.

7\. Process Improvement

\- Identify bottlenecks in the production process and implement improvements.

\- Improve productivity, reduce rejection/rework and control wastage.

\- Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs).

\- Introduce production tracking and performance monitoring systems.

8\. Documentation \& Reporting

\- Maintain daily production reports, rejection/rework reports and manpower reports.

\- Track project\-wise production status.

\- Monitor material consumption and wastage.

\- Submit MIS and production performance reports to management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\- Production target achievement

\- On\-time completion and dispatch

\- Production rejection/rework percentage

\- Material wastage

\- Labour productivity

\- Machine utilization

\- Production cost control

\- Quality compliance

\- Safety and housekeeping standards

Required Experience \& Skills

\- 5–10 years of experience in uPVC window/door manufacturing or a closely related fenestration industry.

\- Strong knowledge of uPVC window and door fabrication processes.

\- Experience with profile cutting, reinforcement, welding, corner cleaning, hardware, glazing and quality inspection.

\- Strong manpower and production\-floor management skills.

\- Ability to read technical drawings and understand window/door configurations.

\- Good knowledge of production planning, inventory coordination and quality control.

\- Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.

\- Working knowledge of MS Excel and production reporting systems.

Preferred

\- Experience handling project\-based as well as retail production.

\- Experience with multiple uPVC profile systems/series.

\- Exposure to aluminium/system\-aluminium production will be an advantage.

\- Experience in setting up or streamlining a uPVC production facility will be an added advantage.

Personal Attributes

\- Leadership and team\-management skills

\- Strong sense of ownership

\- Process\-oriented approach

\- Good communication and coordination

\- Ability to work under production deadlines

\- Focus on quality, productivity and cost control

Overall Responsibility:

The Production Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the factory operates efficiently and that the required quantity and quality of uPVC windows and doors are manufactured and made ready for dispatch as per the planned schedule.

Every payment Amazon makes to a supplier starts with a promise \- and the Accounts Payable Operations team is the engine that keeps that promise, at massive scale, across dozens of subsidiaries and global marketplaces. As a FinOps Manager – AP, you’ll lead a core US\-shift team responsible for the full invoice lifecycle \- from ingestion through successful payment execution \- ensuring that tens of thousands of vendors worldwide are paid accurately and on time.

The role will have end\-to\-end ownership of the Accounts Payable process, from invoice ingestion through invoice processing, exception/hold resolution, and successful payment execution. **Job Title:** F5 Load Balancer \- Level 3 Engineer


**Job Summary** **:**

We are seeking an experienced F5 Load Balancer L3 Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize network load balancing infrastructure. This role is crucial to ensure high availability, performance, and security of applications delivered through F5 technologies. As an L3 engineer, you will work on complex troubleshooting, configuration, and implementation tasks, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless service delivery.


**Responsibilities** **:**

* **F5 Load Balancer Administration:**
* + Implementation and manage F5 load balancers (LTM, GTM, ASM, APM modules).
	+ Develop and implement F5 profiles, rules and policies to meet business requirements.
	+ Maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot F5 infrastructure to ensure uptime and reliability.
	+ Analyze logs and performance data to proactively identify and resolve issues.
	+ Implement health checks and failover strategies to ensure high availability of applications.
* **Firewall Administration:**
* + Network Security
	+ Manage Checkpoint/Cisco ASA firewalls
	+ Provide support for firewalls
* **Troubleshooting:**
* + Serve as the Level 3 (L3\) escalation point for resolving complex network and application\-related issues.
	+ Troubleshoot and resolve connectivity, traffic flow, and application performance issues involving F5 products.
* **Collaboration:**
* + Work closely with network engineers and application teams to ensure alignment on load balancing requirements.
	+ Collaborate on security compliance audits and assessments related to load balancing and traffic management.
* **Security:**
* + Implement security measures such as SSL offloading, web application firewalls (WAF), and DDoS protection on F5 devices.
	+ Stay updated on the latest security threats and ensure configurations are optimized to mitigate risks.
* **Documentation:**
* + Create and maintain documentation for F5 configurations, processes, and network architecture.
	+ Provide technical training and knowledge transfer to junior engineers or team members.
* **Automation \& Optimization:**
* + Automate routine tasks using F5 iControl REST API and scripting languages such as Python or Bash.
	+ Propose improvements and optimization strategies for load balancing services.

**Requirements:**

* **Education:**
* + Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Experience:**
* + 6\+ years of hands\-on experience with F5 load balancers (BIG\-IP LTM, GTM, ASM, APM). Checkpoint or ASA firewalls.
	+ Proven expertise in designing and implementing advanced load balancing solutions.
	+ Experience with networking protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP, SSL, DNS, and related technologies.
* **Skills:**
* + Proficiency in writing and debugging F5 iRules.
	+ Strong understanding of application traffic flows and troubleshooting techniques.
	+ Knowledge of network security principles, SSL certificates, and encryption methodologies. Firewall management
	+ Familiarity with other load balancers, firewalls, and web proxies is a plus.
	+ Familiarity with cloud\-based load balancing solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP).
	+ Experience with DevOps tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Jenkins for infrastructure automation.
* **Soft Skills:**
* + Flexible to work according to requirements
	+ Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.
	+ Strong communication skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
	+ Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently or collaboratively.
* **Certifications:**
* + F5 Certified BIG\-IP Administrator (F5\-CA) or higher certification is preferred.
	+ CCNA/CCNP or other relevant network certifications are good to have.
